verdict.rationale: Ollama ships a shell-script install (`curl | sh`) and a REST API for running and managing models. Community users report running it on Linux for inference "for ages" even though the GUI app did not exist on Linux, and others note ROCm containers and server-style deployments such as a Discord bot backend, which together show it runs as a GUI-less server runtime. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs for headless/server mode (e.g. a documented serve daemon or official container image), any evidence of CI-pipeline usage, documented server configuration options.
